ev.q: This report describes the detection of medetomidine from illicit agents among patients evaluated in an emergency department (ED) after suspected opioid overdoses
Detection of Medetomidine Among Patients Evaluated in Emergency Departments for Suspected Opioid Overdoses
Medetomidine, a veterinary anesthetic drug, is an emerging adulterant detected in illicit drugs, drug paraphernalia, and overdoses.
among a series of patients who used illicit drugs
